name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap with Special Sauce, Blue Cheese & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place turkey, egg, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb ground turkey
1 egg
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the mushrooms are cooking, place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tsp ketchup
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are done, add additional vinegar and cook until dry, 15-30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Add burgers to the plate with the mushrooms and re-cover with foil.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp white wine vinegar
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside two leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, on each plate; top with special sauce, burgers, mushrooms, blue cheese, and pickled onions. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled blue cheese
